description: This file defines the interface and data structures for interacting with an object database in a version control system, including functions for reading, writing, and managing objects and sources.

classes.name: odb_source
classes.description: Represents a source of objects in the object database, such as the main directory or alternates, including metadata like path and local status.

classes.name: object_database
classes.description: Encapsulates access to objects within a repository, managing sources, transactions, and object caching.

classes.name: object_info
classes.description: Structure used to hold information about a specific object, including type, size, and location details.

classes.name: odb_write_stream
classes.description: Interface for streaming object data into the database during write operations.

methods.name: compute_alternate_path
methods.description: Computes the exact filesystem path of an alternate object store.

methods.name: odb_new
methods.description: Creates a new object database instance for a repository.

methods.name: odb_free
methods.description: Releases resources associated with an object database.

methods.name: odb_close
methods.description: Closes the database and releases resources, allowing reuse.

methods.name: odb_reprepare
methods.description: Reloads alternates and refreshes object sources.

methods.name: odb_transaction_begin
methods.description: Starts a new transaction for batch object operations.

methods.name: odb_transaction_commit
methods.description: Commits the current transaction, making objects visible.

methods.name: odb_find_source
methods.description: Finds a source by its directory path.

methods.name: odb_find_source_or_die
methods.description: Finds a source by path or terminates if not found.

methods.name: odb_set_temporary_primary_source
methods.description: Replaces the primary source temporarily.

methods.name: odb_restore_primary_source
methods.description: Restores the primary source to a previous state.

methods.name: odb_add_submodule_source_by_path
methods.description: Adds a submodule's object store as a source.

methods.name: odb_for_each_alternate
methods.description: Iterates over all alternate sources, executing a callback.

methods.name: odb_for_each_alternate_ref
methods.description: Iterates over references of alternate sources.

methods.name: odb_mkstemp
methods.description: Creates a temporary file in the object store directory.

methods.name: odb_prepare_alternates
methods.description: Prepares alternate sources based on configuration.

methods.name: odb_has_alternates
methods.description: Checks if the database has alternate sources.

methods.name: odb_add_to_alternates_file
methods.description: Adds an alternate directory to the on-disk list.

methods.name: odb_add_to_alternates_memory
methods.description: Adds an alternate directory to the in-memory list.

methods.name: odb_read_object
methods.description: Reads an object by its ID, returning data and metadata.

methods.name: odb_read_object_info_extended
methods.description: Retrieves detailed info about an object.

methods.name: odb_write_object_ext
methods.description: Writes an object to the database with extended options.

methods.name: odb_write_object_stream
methods.description: Streams object data into the database.
